title: Linear Algebra Done Right
summary: This is a comprehensive mathematics textbook focused on abstract vector spaces and linear maps, intended for students who have had a previous introductory exposure to the subject. title: Book of Proof
summary: This textbook provides a comprehensive introduction to mathematical proof techniques, covering fundamental topics such as set theory, logic, counting, and various methods of proof including induction and contradiction. title: Principles of Mathematical Analysis
